title: Our Sacred Aspiration (Ka Jingthrang Jong Ngi)
cultural_context: Inspirational anthem expressing the high intellectual, moral, and cultural aspirations of young Khasi scholars, from 'Ki Khasi Poems'.

khasi: Ka jingthrang jong ngi ka kiew sha bneng,
Ban wad ia ka stad ba shisha;
Ban pynphriang ia ka jingshai ha ka ri,
Ban beh noh ia ka jingdum baroh;
Ngi long ki samla ba don ka jingkyrmen,
Ba bat ia ka burom jong u Hynniewtrep;
Ha ki skul, ha ki khet, ha ki madan,
Ngin ieng ban trei na ka bynta ka ri.
english: Our aspiration ascends unto the sky,
To seek out true enlightenment and knowledge;
To diffuse radiant light across the land,
To banish completely all ignorance and darkness;
We are the youths anchored in high hope,
Holding high the honor of the Seven Huts;
In classrooms, in halls of state, on open fields,
We shall labor for the welfare of our country.

khasi: Khlem ka jingtieng, khlem ka jingshepteng,
Ngin kiew ia ki riat bad ki lum;
Ka ktien jong ngi kan don ka bor
Ban ring ia ka jingsuk ba pura;
U Blei Uba Donbor Un kyrkhu ia ngi,
Un pynskhem ia la ka kti;
Haduh ba ka ri Khasi kan kiew
Ha ka nam bad ka spah ba shisha.
english: Without fear, without hesitation or dread,
We shall climb the sheer crags and peaks;
Our mother tongue shall possess the power
To usher in lasting, untroubled peace;
Almighty God shall shower His blessings upon us,
He shall strengthen our hands for the task;
Until our beloved Khasi land ascends
In true renown and genuine spiritual riches.
